events.description:
Join us as we raise the flag in honour of Childhood Cancer Awareness Month.

This special ceremony recognizes children and families affected by childhood cancer and helps raise awareness of the challenges they face. Residents, community members, and families are invited to attend as we come together in support and recognition.

Time: 12 PM
Location: Town Hall, 24 Tupper Street West, Alliston

We look forward to welcoming the community as we mark Childhood Cancer Awareness Month and show our support for those impacted by childhood cancer.

events.title: Flag Raising – Fetal Alcohol Spectrum Disorder Awareness Day
events.description:
Join us as we raise the flag in honour of Fetal Alcohol Spectrum Disorder (FASD) Awareness Day.

This special ceremony recognizes individuals living with FASD and raises awareness about the importance of understanding, inclusion, and support for those affected, as well as their families and caregivers. Residents and community members are invited to attend as we come together in recognition of FASD Awareness Day.

Date: September 9, 2026
Time: 12 p.m.
Location: Town Hall, 24 Tupper Street West, Alliston

We look forward to welcoming the community as we raise the flag and show our support for greater awareness, understanding, and inclusion.

events.title: Mayor Richard Norcross Charity Event
events.description:
Mayor Norcross’ Charity Bursary Cup Classic Returns September 15, 2026

The Town of New Tecumseth is proud to announce the return of the Mayor Richard Norcross’ Charity Bursary Cup Classic, taking place on September 15, 2026. This popular nine-hole scramble golf tournament brings together community members, local leaders, and supporters for a day of fun and fundraising, all in support of the Mayor’s Student Bursary Program.

Hosted annually, the tournament raises vital funds to help local students pursue post-secondary education. Whether you’re a seasoned golfer or just looking to support a great cause, the Bursary Cup Classic offers a welcoming and spirited atmosphere for all.

Get ready to tee off for a great cause!

To register or learn more, contact our Mayor’s Event Team at mayorsgolf@newtecumseth.ca

Mayor Richard Norcross’ Charity Bursary Cup Classic 2026 Sponsorship Package

Event Day Schedule:

  • 11:45 AM – Registration Opens
  • 12:00 PM – BBQ Lunch
  • 1:00 PM – Tee Off
  • 4:00 PM – Dinner Reception

events.title: Coffee & Conversation
events.description:
Join us at your museum twice a month to enjoy a cup of coffee or tea while chatting about a variety of historical themes and topics! Whether you’re a history buff, a coffee enthusiast, looking for engaging chats — or all three! — your museum staff welcome you to Coffee & Conversation, where we’ll share a brief historical talk, provide hands-on artifacts and resources, and let the symposium begin!

Surrounded by fascinating artifacts from New Tecumseth’s past, each gathering brings local history to life in a friendly and informal setting. Come for the coffee, stay for the conversation — we’d love to see you there.

Register Now

events.title: Doors Open Ontario – New Tecumseth
events.description:
Discover local history, heritage, and hands‑on experiences as New Tecumseth proudly participates in Doors Open Ontario.

On Saturday, September 19, 2026 from 10AM – 4PM, the Museum on the Boyne and the Sir Frederick Banting Homestead & Heritage Park will welcome residents and visitors for a full day of exploration, demonstrations, and family‑friendly activities.

Enjoy heritage interpretation, crafts, demonstrations, and community service displays across two of the Town’s most significant cultural sites. Admission is free, and all ages are invited to take part in this province‑wide celebration of culture.

Museum on the Boyne, 250 Fletcher Crescent, Alliston 

Heritage demonstrations, hands‑on crafts, spinners and weavers, watercolour activities, historical interpretation inside the galleries, complimentary popcorn, and an information tent with program materials and family‑friendly takeaways.

Banting Homestead, 5116 Sir Frederick Banting Road, Alliston 

Outdoor demonstrations, community service displays with Fire Services and EMS onsite, ongoing craft activities inside the visitor centre, cotton candy throughout the day, and an information tent with program materials and family activities.

Event Sponsorships are available! Contact sponsorships@newtecumseth.ca to discuss opportunities.

events.title: Fitness Member Appreciation Day
events.description:
Every fitness journey starts with a single step, but it’s the people we meet along the way that help make the experience meaningful.

Join us for Fitness Member Appreciation Day as we celebrate the members, instructors, staff, and community that make fitness in New Tecumseth such a welcoming and supportive experience.

Whether you’re a long-time fitness member, just beginning your wellness journey, or looking to explore everything our fitness facilities have to offer, everyone’s invited.

Come celebrate the people who make fitness in New Tecumseth more than just a workout.

Date: September 27
Time: 11 AM – 1PM
Location: Tottenham Fitness and Community Centre

We look forward to welcoming current members, future members, and anyone interested in exploring fitness opportunities in New Tecumseth.

events.title: Cemetery Tour – Alliston Union
events.description:
Step back in time and discover the stories that shaped our community at Alliston Union Cemetery. Located on Victoria Street East, this peaceful cemetery serves as the final resting place for generations of local residents, community builders, veterans, business leaders, and pioneering families who helped establish and grow our community.

The address for this tour is 445 Victoria Street East, Alliston. Please park at the rear of the cemetery, in the field and meet the instructor at the white shed. This program runs rain or shine.

Please note as this is an active cemetery, this tour may be rescheduled last minute.

View additional details or register now.

events.title: Antique Winter Workshop
events.description:
Join us at the Museum on the Boyne for a cozy and creative series of historical craft workshops! Step inside, warm up, and get ready for the holiday season as you create unique handmade keepsakes to treasure for yourself or share as thoughtful gifts with loved ones.

We will learn about traditional crafting techniques and create holiday decor the way it was created during holiday seasons of yore.

Crafts will include dried orange garlands, tin-punch ornaments, candle-making, and more!

Open to participants aged 16 years +.

December 12 workshop – Register Now.
